verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships official error-reporting libraries for over 50 platforms, including the open-source bugsnag-js SDK covering browser, Node.js, React Native and framework plugins, with documented APIs such as Bugsnag.notify() and an SDK API for custom performance sessions. A community user reports adding the iOS SDK took minutes. Missing for 10: evidence of an official SDK for the data/management API (the evidenced SDKs are ingestion-side), and AI-friendly SDK documentation (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404).
